feature: MQTT serial QoS2 with multiple zio executors
change: Added netz.runtime.Backend.initWithExecutors and an example broker --executors option so applications can run connection tasks on several zio executors instead of the single default executor.

comparison.observation: Two or four executors produced no consistent gain over the single default executor for the serial window-1 workload; differences stayed within run-to-run noise. The option is retained for workloads with independent connections that can use multiple cores, not as a serial-latency fix.

tests.unit: src/runtime.zig covers a two-executor backend running a concurrent sleep task and rejects zero executors.

notes: The single-executor default keeps scheduling deterministic and is still the right choice for serial workloads. The remaining serial gap is the task/event-loop cost described in 2026-11-06.json.
